proposal.thesis: Booking Holdings printed Q2 2026 (quarter ended 2026-06-30) revenue of $7.352B, +8.15% YoY and 2.26% above the $7.190B Street number, with adjusted EPS of $2.54 vs $2.43 and a fourth straight beat (TIKR / company release 2026-08-04; do not use the digest's 54.4% YoY or $504M net-income figures — both conflict with the sourced release, which implies ~$2.0B of profit on 770M split-adjusted shares). Management guided Q3 room nights +3-5% and revenue / adjusted EBITDA +4-6%, and kept FY2026 adjusted-EPS growth at low-to-mid teens on high-single-digit revenue, which is the 8%/8%/15% long-term algorithm they restated in the Q2 deck. The stock gapped ~6.9% on the print (9 sessions ago, 95% retained) and is digesting that gap on a no_supply_pullback at $208.25 (alpaca_iex 2026-08-18), still 14.2% below the 36-analyst mean target of $237.81. TTM free cash flow is $9.54B and TTM buybacks are $10.53B (6.57% yield) with diluted shares down 5.52% YoY (quality_ratios, period ended 2026-06-30); operating margin expanded to 33.13% TTM from 29.91% a year earlier. This is a different demand_driver (consumer_industrial) with 0.02 corr_to_book and 0.44 beta — a fourth uncorrelated seat, not another AI-stack clone.

proposal.macro_context: Regime is supportive: SPY 767.45 sits above its 50-DMA (749.53) and 200-DMA (703.64), up 3.4% over 1 month, regime_hint 4/5. Momentum_health is healthy (leaders SNOW/DELL/HPE still +18.7% 1m RS; no unwind haircut). Breadth inside the universe is broad (75.8% above the 200-DMA, 60.8% beating SPY over 1m) even though today's A/D was 0.68 on a down tape. The one live flag is rates: the 30-year yield tagged a 19-year high at 5.33% and the 10-year is 4.72%. That is a duration headwind for long-duration growth, which is why I want a 16.8x FCF compounder with a 6.57% buyback yield rather than another 150x software multiple. VIX 15.83 is still calm.
proposal.risk_map: This fails if (1) Q3 room-night growth prints below the 3% low end of the 2026-08-04 guide, or FY26 adj-EPS growth is cut below the low-teens algorithm — early tell is a mid-quarter travel-demand cut from Booking or a peer (ABNB/EXPE); (2) the 6.9% post-print gap fills and the stock closes back through $196, proving the August launch pad was a failed breakout rather than digestion; (3) the AI-agent booking bear case shows up in take-rate or merchant-mix (merchant gross bookings were 73% in Q2, +4pp YoY) — a mix reversal would hit the EPS algorithm even if room nights hold; (4) options already lean put-heavy (P/C vol 2.06, 9.2pp put skew, mild front-month backwardation into the 2026-08-28 expiry) so a rates shock can gap this name harder than the 3.51% ATR implies. CFO 10b5-1 sales on 2026-08-12 are routine, not a new tell.
proposal.variant_perception: CONSENSUS: 36 analysts rate it a buy (mean 1.55) with a $237.81 target, +14.2% from the $208.25 2026-08-18 close, and the Street models ~8.7% forward revenue growth at 16.8x (vs a 23.6x consumer-industrial median). The Q3 guide of room nights +3-5% and revenue +4-6% is being read as a deceleration that keeps the multiple compressed, and the bundle itself flags agentic booking disintermediation as the structural bear. MY VIEW: the 14% gap to the mean target and the 16% PE discount to the sector are the market treating a 1% FX-headwind, tougher-compare Q3 guide as a structural slowdown, while the EPS algorithm (high-single-digit revenue + 6.57% buyback yield + 3.22pp of TTM operating-margin expansion to 33.13%) is intact. MECHANISM: Street NTM models are room-night driven. What they underweight is EPS-per-room-night: $10.53B of TTM buybacks on a $160B cap and a 73% merchant mix (Connected Trip still growing low-double-digits) convert 8% revenue into the low-to-mid-teens EPS the company just reaffirmed. The AI-disintermediation haircut assumes Booking loses the search box; the moat that actually prints cash is supply inventory plus payments, not Google. RESOLUTION: if the stock has not closed above $220 (halfway to the $237.81 mean) by 2026-09-25, the post-print re-rate is not happening and I exit before the 2026-10-27 print rather than carry an ATR stop through that binary.
